newsitem.title: GERMANY: Kohl says Germany to meet strict EMU deficit rule.
newsitem.headline: Kohl says Germany to meet strict EMU deficit rule.

text.p: Chancellor Helmut Kohl said on Tuesday that Germany would meet the deficit criterion for European monetary union by the strict definition of 3.0 percent of gross domestic product in 1997 and 1998.
Critics who seek a delay in EMU are making an error, and the timetable should be adhered to, he said.
"We are sticking to three-point-zero. That is no problem. And with the schedule," Kohl said at an entrepreneurs' conference.
The Bonn coalition is firm in its desire that the new currency be stable, he said. "That stands, that is binding, we don't have to discuss that all."
"Those who seek an exit through the timetable are in error", he said.
